about: Thresholds for the one-product report. scripts/product_report.py reads this file. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.page_size: Products on the first page. A product ranked deeper than this is 'not on page one' (also --page-size).
notes.max_rows_per_call: Largest rows value to request from search_discovery_product_grid_insights; rows=500 and above return HTTP 500.
notes.top_queries: How many top queries by revenue to read from get_discovery_query_performance when choosing which searches to check.
notes.max_query_grids: At most this many search grids are fetched for the product (the most relevant top queries), to keep the call count small.
notes.max_peer_lookups: At most this many peer products (from page one of the product's main category) get a get_discovery_product_performance call.
notes.min_peers: With fewer peers than this, the peer comparison is reported as not checked rather than judged.
notes.weak_ratio: A metric below this share of the peer median is weak (for example conversion rate under 75% of similar products).
notes.strong_ratio: A metric above this share of the peer median is strong; a strong product ranked off page one is worth a look.
notes.low_stock_values: Catalog stock_level or availability values (lower-cased) that count as low or out of stock.
notes.required_fields: Catalog fields a product should have; each missing one is a data gap handed to product-data-enhancer.
notes.max_actions: How many next actions the report lists, most important first.
